name: Poushya Parva
note: It is the story of Poushya. After the first two sections, which are really summaries and no more, Section 3 is where the main story of the Mahabharata should begin. But not only is this section mostly in prose, unlike the rest of the Mahab-harata, it has little to do with the main story, since it has all kinds of incidents that don�t quite belong. All this section does is set up the snake-sacrifice.
